gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns the missing distributional premise for the random translation vectors Delta_j in the block-affine scramble, including the resulting failure of uniformity. ISSUE-001 instead diagnoses an omitted f_emptyset term in an ANOVA/Walsh identity and does not recognize the missing randomization assumption or its uniformity consequence.

Both identify the same gain-normalization defect: an extra factor 1/n makes the definition inconsistent with the double-sum expansion and the stated gain and variance identities. ISSUE-002 also gives the corresponding correction and downstream normalization consequences.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The gain coefficient is scaled by an erroneous extra factor 1/n, so the defining equations, gain identities, and variance formula use incompatible normalizations and require the stated compensating correction.
